searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/271 if there's anyone with skin in the EIP4844 game, maybe glance over the API types... It's not really changed for a while, may be almost time to merge... Happy to code the batch if there's a strong preference. Not a hill I'm willing to die, or spent much time on I had a fairly strong preference to make life easier for users, but there were several ppl that didn't want it to the point of a 50/50 for and against. My preference would usually be to make things more similar to work flows that ppl will actually use. To me it seemed logical especially if ethdo literally provides that as an output if its offline. Currently the work flow if you're offline will involve generating a file, taking it to the BN, and running each one over curl for us, and that's not super great. I can re-open the PR or put a new one up with just that if there's enough sentiment. I do think it's the right way to go but i'm out of time for arguments this year (literally - holidays after today :D) batching is fine 🙂 we can reopen the PR i'll put up a fresh one without changes.md - i had put that as a separate pr when i closed the other one. both those responses are directly at odds with what you said on PR .... just saying 😛 posting single is for my convenience, posting multiple is for user's convenience I guess the latter is more important maybe i didnt explain it well on PR... if thats the case, apologies... Adrian had a red-hot go i thought your life would be too easy ;P https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/279 is up - <@144468805697929216> worth being aware of this
